records.title: Research on World Models Is Not Merely Injecting World Knowledge into Specific Tasks
records.reason: The paper discusses and organizes world-model research without presenting a concrete LLM inference optimization.

records.title: Mamba-STR: Efficient context-aware scene text recognition framework with selective state space modeling
records.reason: Mamba-STR is selective-SSM scene text recognition; reported compute, GPU-memory, and speed gains are visual OCR model results, not a demonstrated LLM inference method.

records.title: Distill3R: A Pipeline for Democratizing 3D Foundation Models on Commodity Hardware
records.reason: Distill3R distills a 3D reconstruction vision model for commodity hardware; its size/speed results are task-specific, not LLM inference.

records.title: Improved Object-Centric Diffusion Learning with Registers and Contrastive Alignment
records.reason: The paper improves object-centric image learning with diffusion registers/contrastive alignment and does not report LLM-serving gains.

records.title: Feature Responsive LoRA: Toward Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for Self-Supervised Visual Models
records.reason: Tried the primary IEEE DOI/publisher page, which was inaccessible in the available reader; only abstract/metadata-level material was available, so primary methods/results could not be checked.
